audience: operations and marketing teams who send postcards, letters and checks by mail with Lob

useCases.title: Check if a US or international address is deliverable
useCases.text: The AI verifies an address and returns deliverability, corrected components and a confidence score for US addresses. No mail is sent.

useCases.title: Complete an address or look up a ZIP code
useCases.text: The AI suggests full US addresses from a partial first line, or returns the cities and state for a ZIP code.

useCases.title: Review sent postcards and letters and their status
useCases.text: The AI lists postcards or letters, newest first, and opens one to show its status, tracking or expected delivery.

useCases.title: Save an address and send a postcard or letter
useCases.text: The AI saves a reusable address record, then sends a postcard or letter to it. Sending charges your Lob account, so use a test key to avoid real mail.

useCases.title: Cancel a scheduled postcard before it is mailed
useCases.text: The AI finds a scheduled postcard and cancels it before its send date, so it is never mailed or billed.
